_meta.paper: Wang J.-H., Ren J., Liu W., Wu X.-Y., Gao M.-X., Bai P.-K. — Effect of Selective Laser Melting Process Parameters on Microstructure and Properties of Co-Cr Alloy
_meta.source_document: Open-access full text: PMC6164890 (Europe PMC PDF render, 13 pp., verified against PMC HTML)
_meta.extraction_method: Laser parameters and the four depth values quoted in body text transcribed from typeset text. Pool width/depth per condition transcribed from Figures 6 and 8, which are annotated schematic cross-sections with the numeric values PRINTED as text labels on each pool sketch — not bar charts, so no axis digitization was needed and extraction_uncertainty_um = 0 (transcription of printed numbers). Text-quoted depths (51, 64, 61, 51 um) agree exactly with the figure labels. No table or supplementary file carries these numbers.

laser.laser_model: SPI redPOWER, stated as '200 W' model
laser.machine_power_note: Paper is self-contradictory: 'The equipment is equipped with a fiber laser with a power of 400 W. The laser model was an SDH Physical Interface (SPI) red POWER 200 W' — yet tested powers reach 300 W. AM 400 ships with a 400 W optic; the '200 W' is likely an error carried from the older AM 250. Recorded verbatim.
laser.spot_convention_note: Paper wording: 'the beam focusing diameter can reach 70 um' — explicitly a diameter. Verified.
laser.output_mode: pulsed (Renishaw modulated exposure); point distance and exposure time NOT stated anywhere in the paper — powers and speeds are given as continuous P (W) and v (mm/s) only
laser.layer_thickness_source: Sec. 3.1: 'The thickness of the paving layer used in this experiment was 30 um' — verified
laser.scan_pitch_note: Sec. 3.1 says 'scan line spacing of 0.05 um' for the power series; this is a typo for 0.05 mm (Table 2 lists H = 0.05 mm for A1-A5)
laser.powder: remanium star CL dental CoCr (paper spells the supplier 'Denkurum Company, Pforzheim, Germany' — the actual supplier is Dentaurum, Pforzheim)

composition_wt_pct._source: Table 1 as printed: only Co, W, Si, other are listed
composition_wt_pct.Cr_note: Cr is absent from the printed table; it is the balance (~28 wt% per the remanium star CL datasheet). Inference, not from the paper.

laser._source: Sec. 2.1 (materials, Table 1) and 'All parts were made with the Renishaw AM 400...' paragraph, p. 2-3

conditions._measurement_note: Each width/depth is the AVERAGE of 20 molten pools measured at the top of the etched cross-section of a bulk sample (optical microscopy). The paper reports NO standard deviation, error bar, or n-based uncertainty anywhere for pool geometry: error_bars = null below is a statement about the source, not an oversight. Pools are track cross-sections inside a hatched bulk build (scan pitch 0.05 mm, 90-degree layer rotation), so widths partially overlap neighbouring tracks — these are not isolated single tracks on bare plate.
conditions._figure_note: Figures 6 and 8 print each w and h value as a text annotation over a schematic pool arc; values below transcribed verbatim (extraction_uncertainty_um = 0). Figure 10 contains no pool dimensions — its 'h = 40/50/60 um' labels are the scan pitches of Table 2 (0.04/0.05/0.06 mm), not depths.

power_series._source: Figure 6; depths for 140 W and 220 W also quoted in body text (Sec. 3.1)

speed_series._source: Figure 8; depths for 700 and 1100 mm/s also quoted in body text (Sec. 3.1)
speed_series._note: B2 (900 mm/s) is the same condition as A2 and carries identical values in both figures
